name: caroline
title_zh: 全局热键唤出的桌面 AI 秘书，托盘常驻不占窗口
tagline_zh: 写邮件时不用切走当前窗口——按一下热键，带人格设定的 Claude 就浮在眼前。
tagline_en: No alt-tab while drafting emails—hotkey summons a persona'd Claude. SquirrelWisdom tools read local ephemeris &.
desc_en: Standalone desktop AI secretary built on the Claude Agent SDK -- tray app, global hotkey, WPF chat UI, persona/voice, SquirrelWisdom-backed tools.
why_zh: 把 Agent SDK 的会话状态、工具调用和 WPF 界面缝成一个常驻进程，热键即达。
why_en: Seams Agent SDK sessions, tool calls, and WPF into one resident process, hotkey-reachable. Persona & voice built-in, not bolted.
limit_zh: 只认 Windows 桌面；需要 .NET 8 运行时和 Claude API key。
limit_en: Windows-only; needs .NET 8 & Claude API key. SquirrelWisdom covers ephemeris & BaZi only—outside that, it says no.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Desktop AI secretary on hotkey, tray-resident
